text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've just finished observing a race
when...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That was a most excellent race. It
offered plenty
of points to learn from,
don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The first-place winner was particularly

exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
From her positioning and route selection
to the timing of her final push,
everything about her
strategy was
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I wanted to win against someone of
her caliber,
what approach would be
most effective, I
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. That would prevent them from

conserving the strength in their legs
properly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, and if one is able to pull that

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I thoroughly discuss
various
strategies to apply pressure on
opponents during
races.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see... Better to bend than to break, as
the saying
goes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Staying close to an opponent from start
to finish
will greatly hinder their ability
to run... That is
quite an excellent tactic, I must say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I leisurely discuss the

intricacies of how to target a formidable

opponent during a race.
